translations.EN: I appreciate that more than you know.
translations.TL: Mas pinahahalagahan ko iyan kaysa sa iniisip mo.

translations.EN: That means a great deal to me.
translations.TL: Malaking bagay iyan para sa akin.

translations.EN: Thank you. That means a lot out here.
translations.TL: Salamat. Malaking tulong ang marinig iyan dito.

translations.EN: I do not hear that often. Thank you.
translations.TL: Bihira kong marinig 'yan. Maraming salamat.

translations.EN: Hearing that really helps keep me going.
translations.TL: Ang marinig 'yan ay nakakatulong sa pagpapatuloy ko.

translations.EN: I am grateful for your words.
translations.TL: Nagpapasalamat ako sa iyong mga salita.

translations.EN: That is very kind. Thank you.
translations.TL: Napakabait mo naman. Salamat.

translations.EN: I try my best. It is good to know you see that.
translations.TL: Ginagawa ko ang makakaya ko. Mabuting malaman na nakikita mo 'yon.

translations.EN: I appreciate the respect.
translations.TL: Salamat sa respeto.

translations.EN: That really touches me. Thanks.
translations.TL: Tumatagos talaga sa akin 'yan. Salamat.

translations.EN: That is kind of you to say.
translations.TL: Mabait sa 'yo ang magsabi niyan.

translations.EN: Thank you. You did not have to say that, but thanks.
translations.TL: Salamat. Hindi mo naman kailangang sabihin, pero salamat pa rin.

translations.EN: I appreciate the thought.
translations.TL: Salamat sa magandang kaisipan.

translations.EN: You are generous with your words.
translations.TL: Bukas-palad ka sa iyong papuri.

translations.EN: That is good of you to say.
translations.TL: Mabuting tao ka para sabihin 'yan.

translations.EN: I take that as high praise.
translations.TL: Itinuturing ko 'yang mataas na papuri.

translations.EN: Thanks. I appreciate the courtesy.
translations.TL: Salamat. Pinahahalagahan ko ang galang mo.

translations.EN: It is nice to hear something decent for once.
translations.TL: Masarap makarinig ng maayos na salita paminsan-minsan.

translations.EN: Thank you for saying so.
translations.TL: Salamat sa pagsasabi niyan.

translations.EN: That is good to hear.
translations.TL: Magandang marinig 'yan.

translations.EN: You see more in me than most people do.
translations.TL: Mas marami kang nakikita sa akin kaysa sa karamihan.

translations.EN: Most folks out here would never notice that. Thanks.
translations.TL: Karamihan ng tao rito ay hindi 'yan mapapansin. Salamat.

translations.EN: It is rare to find someone who actually pays attention.
translations.TL: Bihira makahanap ng taong talagang nagmamasid.

translations.EN: I am glad someone recognizes what I put into this.
translations.TL: Mabuti naman at may nakakapansin sa pagsusumikap ko.

translations.EN: You have a good eye. I appreciate that.
translations.TL: Matalas ang mata mo. Salamat.

translations.EN: Not many people look closely enough to see that.
translations.TL: Kakaunti lang ang taong tumitingin nang malalim para makita 'yan.

translations.EN: That means something coming from you.
translations.TL: May bigat 'yan lalo't nanggaling sa 'yo.

translations.EN: I did not expect you to see that. Thank you.
translations.TL: Hindi ko inasahang mapapansin mo 'yon. Salamat.

translations.EN: You give me credit where others would not.
translations.TL: Binibigyan mo ako ng tiwala kung saan ang iba ay hindi.

translations.EN: I appreciate that you see what I am trying to do.
translations.TL: Salamat dahil naiintindihan mo ang sinusubukan kong gawin.
